summary: GM Financial Automobile Leasing Trust 2026-2 filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of $1.25 billion in asset-backed notes secured by auto leases. The trust issued Class A-1 through A-4 notes ($1.13B), Class B notes ($61.8M), and Class C notes ($57M) with fixed/floating rates from 3.831% to 4.70%. The securities were sold via Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, SG Americas, and TD Securities. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown for securitization funding, not a special situation. What to watch: performance of underlying lease assets and prepayment speeds.
